_comment: Machine-readable companion to ai-crawler-agents.md. ROLE, not vendor, decides whether a robots block is a defect. A token absent from this table has role 'unknown' and must never be the sole basis for a finding. This list ages: new agents appear a few times a year, and the correct failure mode is silence, not a guess.

cost_of_blocking.training: nothing in citations; it is a legitimate content-licensing choice
cost_of_blocking.retrieval: eligibility for AI answers and search citations, entirely
cost_of_blocking.user-triggered: answers about a page a user explicitly asked the assistant to read

special_cases.Googlebot: Also gates Google's AI surfaces. There is no way to opt out of AI Overviews separately from Google Search; Google-Extended only affects training.
